record.body:
## Evidence

status_cli applies apply_landing_needs; the web path does not. The design Interfaces say '--count prints the merged needs-you count' and Architecture says status is built on gates.landings_for_snapshot.

## Consequence

Phase merge is blocked until the finding is fixed or cleared.

## Follow-up

Kept as designed: the settled design names the landing merge. Revisit if the web UI should show merge-branch items too.

payload.basis: status_cli applies apply_landing_needs; the web path does not. The design Interfaces say '--count prints the merged needs-you count' and Architecture says status is built on gates.landings_for_snapshot.
payload.claim: judgment on status-cli: orchestra status counts merge-branch landings that the web count omits
payload.invalidated_when: the fix lands and the reviewer re-run passes, or a human clears it
